subtitle: Here’s what’s happening on your account.

onboarding.title: Your beta activation checklist
onboarding.description: New to Barter Platform? Complete these steps to understand how barter works, publish your first listing, and reach your first trade faster.

feedback.title: Tell us what felt unclear
feedback.description: Send onboarding feedback whenever something feels confusing about listings, templates, offers, or safety guidance.
feedback.doneDescription: You already sent beta feedback once — thank you. You can always send another note after trying more flows.

verifyEmail.title: Verify your email
verifyEmail.description: Confirm your account so you can complete the rest of the beta journey with confidence.

createListing.title: Create your first listing
createListing.description: Start with one item you already have and describe what makes it worth trading.

uploadPhoto.title: Upload your first photo
uploadPhoto.description: Photos make listings easier to trust and help other traders understand what you are offering.

publishListing.title: Publish your first listing
publishListing.description: Move a draft into the marketplace when it is ready to receive offers.

browseMarketplace.title: Browse the marketplace
browseMarketplace.description: Explore live listings to see how barter works in the community and what kinds of offers are possible.

sendOffer.title: Send your first offer
sendOffer.description: Choose a listing you like and propose a trade so you can experience the full exchange flow.

emptyMarketplace.title: No tradeable items from other users right now.
emptyMarketplace.description: Check back soon — new items appear here as they’re listed.

emptyTrade.title: No recent trade activity right now.
emptyTrade.description: Trade activity will appear here once you start trading.
